name: Banded Tussock Moth
desc: Banded Tussock Moth (Halysidota tessellaris): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Halysidota tessellaris, also called the pale tiger moth, banded tussock moth, and tessellated halisidota, is in the family Erebidae and the tribe Arctiini, the tiger moths.
